verses.text: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.

segments.text: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge:

verses.text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.

segments.text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me:
Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.text: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.

segments.text: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort:
Thou hast given commandment to save me;

verses.text: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

segments.text: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked,

verses.text: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: Thou art my trust from my youth.

segments.text: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah:

my trust from my youth.

verses.text: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.

segments.text: By thee have I been holden up from the womb;

verses.text: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.

segments.text: I am as a wonder unto many;

verses.text: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.

segments.text: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise,

verses.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.

segments.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age;

verses.text: For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,

segments.text: For mine enemies speak concerning me;

verses.text: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.

segments.text: Saying, God hath forsaken him:

verses.text: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.

segments.text: O God, be not far from me;

verses.text: Let them be put to shame and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.

verses.text: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.

verses.text: My mouth shall tell of thy righteousness, And of thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.

verses.text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

verses.text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

segments.text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth;

verses.text: Yea, even when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not, Until I have declared thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.

verses.text: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?

verses.text: Thou, who hast showed us many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken us again, And wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.text: Increase thou my greatness, And turn again and comfort me.

verses.text: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, Even thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing praises with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: My lips shall shout for joy when I sing praises unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.text: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long; For they are put to shame, for they are confounded, that seek my hurt.
